title: CastSense
tagline: Get a pulse on your farcaster activity and followers with relevant analytics
description:
CastSense provides personalized analytics to farcaster users to better understand their engagement trends and follower activity.

Specifically it includes
- metrics like 30d change in number of casts/ mentions/ likes/ replies/ new followers
- follower activity during the week visualized in an easy to interpret heatmap
- active channels from followers 
- followers segmented by different tiers to easily understand the type of followers you have
how_its_made:
- Project uses frog. a minimal and lightweight framework to build and test farcaster frames. 

- It leverages dune APIs and neynar dataset to compute various analytics per farcaster user which are filtered using the new filter feature to dramatically optimize usage and performance. 

- It leverages OpenRank APIs from karmalabs to ensure that activity from low quality users/ bot accounts are not polluting key metrics

- Service itself is built and deployed using vercel
